cross_check_against_decisions_md.transcript_evidence: Consistent throughout -- every mention treats 0009 as an already-settled, deliberately-parked direction, never as something being reopened or executed. No contradiction found.
cross_check_against_decisions_md.caveat: This transcript window (starts 2026-07-20) never shows 0009 being ORIGINALLY ruled -- only it being invoked as precedent and later status-audited. The original ruling conversation, if one exists as a Cowork session, is outside the corpus this scan covers.

why_this_is_a_good_benchmark_item: It's a genuine two-conversation, week-apart story, but a much smaller one than 0017's -- a good test of whether a model can correctly scope a small story small, rather than padding it with invented detail to look more thorough.

It tests whether a model distinguishes 'cited as precedent' from 'being actively decided' -- every mention here is the former, and a naive read could mistake the repeated invocation for ongoing debate.
It has an honest gap (the original ruling isn't in this transcript window) that DECISIONS.md alone can't fill either -- a good answer should say so rather than fabricate an origin scene.
